data.title: 楪祈 · 歌姬舞台
data.description: 【楪祈 · 歌姬舞台】璀璨夺目的巨大舞台中央，无数聚光灯如利剑般汇聚在金红色的歌姬礼服之上。楪祈闭上双眸轻启朱唇，如天籁般空灵凄美的歌声瞬间穿透全场，音符化作抚慰灵魂的实体光粒在空气中浮动——「即使世界被绝望彻底撕裂……只要我的歌声还能传达到你的耳畔，希望就永远不会熄灭。」
data.action: 穿红色层叠长袖舞台礼裙闭眼歌唱，金色灯光与光粒围绕
data.promptProse: Inori sings at the concert-stage center with closed eyes and relaxed hands before her, lips slightly parted beneath pink-to-orange hair and red ornaments. Her red long-sleeved gown has a layered skirt in the medium view. Converging gold spotlights reveal the facing fabric folds, while red stage light outlines the opposite sleeve against the dark venue. Small luminous particles rise around her as a visual echo of the song, leaving her face unobscured.
